subject: the base's key bus tap (dsp-sites.json feature 8): the one-pass tap of Sidechain Compressor 0.2.0, 25 executed instructions a sample for a core's four tracks
unit: Octatrack MKII (the owner's), over USB, OS 1.40C

base.note: A RAM-booted development twin of base/octatrack-next 9ac83b232 (base 0.8's tree before its release rebuild) with the beta flags and --dev (ot/rel-08/twin.sh). Repeated on twin 1c937ed6, the same tree with the 0.8.1 receiver change (base/receiver-one-word-forms), whose tap words are the same.

method: The 23 October 2026 method (keybus-tap-timing-20261023.json), repeated: the base's load meter, core 0's main-loop idle passes a frame as `stats` prints them (the mean of the last 1,024-frame window), read three times 3 s apart per state; one idle pass is 20.0 chip cycles (status.c idle_cycles[0]). Project LIVE/Dev17, bank C, pattern C01 on Part 1, every slot FILTER/DELAY, sequencer stopped, Sidechain Compressor not installed, RINGMOD SC in a rolled-back trial. OFF: installed, on no track, so the base holds no key bus (MWEV byte 53 = 0x00). ON: RINGMOD SC on T1 FX1 with KEY OFF, so the base holds the bus on both cores (MWEV bytes 53-55 = 0x01 0x80 0x80). T1 runs on core 1, so core 0 (T5-T8) carries the tap and no instance; its difference is the tap alone. T1 FX1 was put back to FILTER for a second OFF reading, then the trial rolled back.

readings.note: the first read, 4 s after the pick, still showed the OFF window and is left out
the first read still held frames of a 15 s play and is left out

result.derivation: (2108.37 - 2074.6) passes x 20 cycles / 16 samples = 42.2 cycles a sample on 856cbbcf; (2108.5 - 2074.8) x 20 / 16 = 42.1 on 1c937ed6. Charged rounded up, so the charge still covers the tap.

previousCharge.measuredOn: the 41-instruction tap, before Sidechain Compressor 0.2.0's one-pass tap

limits: Core 0 only, as before. Core 1's difference (214 passes) also holds RINGMOD SC's own instance and the FILTER it replaced on T1, so it does not isolate the tap; core 1 is charged the same figure, as both cores run the same tap over their own four tracks.
Sequencer stopped. The tap's path does not depend on the audio or the transport.
The meter counts the frame's waits for the host and DMA as busy, so it is conservative.
The survey's estimate of about 31 (51 scaled by 25/41) assumed the cycles scale with the instruction count; the one-pass tap runs about 1.7 cycles an instruction against the old tap's 1.24.
